cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stores FROM analytics.dim_store AS s JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE r.city = 'Surabaya' AND s.is_open
assumptions: Interpreted “have” as currently open stores, excluding permanently closed stores.
cases.answer: The company has 5 currently open stores in Surabaya.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS active_products FROM analytics.dim_product AS p JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS top ON top.category_id = c.parent_category_id WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND top.category_name_id = 'Elektronik'
assumptions: Elektronik refers to the department, including its subcategories.
cases.answer: Terdapat 38 produk aktif di kategori Elektronik, dengan Elektronik mencakup seluruh subkategorinya.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.payment_method AS payment_method FROM analytics.fact_payments AS p WHERE p.payment_method IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.payment_method
assumptions: Interpreted “used” as payment methods recorded on orders, regardless of payment status.
cases.answer: Customers have used these payment methods: bank_transfer, card, cash, cod, ewallet, and qris. “Used” includes payment methods recorded on orders regardless of payment status.

cases.sql: SELECT s.opened_date AS opened_date FROM analytics.dim_store AS s WHERE s.store_name = 'Arunika Tangerang Gading Serpong'
assumptions: “Gading Serpong store” refers to Arunika Tangerang Gading Serpong.
cases.answer: Assuming the Gading Serpong store refers to Arunika Tangerang Gading Serpong, it opened on 2025-02-14.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
cases.answer: There have been 2,079 cancelled orders in total.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(sh.shipping_fee_idr) AS total_shipping_fee_idr FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS sh WHERE CAST((sh.shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: “Dikirim selama tahun 2025” means using the shipment date (shipped_at) in WIB.
cases.answer: Total ongkos kirim untuk paket yang dikirim selama tahun 2025 adalah Rp 163 juta rupiah, berdasarkan tanggal pengiriman dalam WIB.

cases.sql: SELECT t.ticket_category, ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.csat_score) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS avg_csat_score FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE t.ticket_status = 'resolved' GROUP BY t.ticket_category
assumptions: Average includes resolved tickets with a recorded CSAT score; tickets with NULL CSAT scores are ignored by AVG.
cases.answer: For resolved support tickets with recorded CSAT scores, the average by category was: payment, 4.07; account, 4.01; product_quality, 4; delivery, 3.44; other, 4.03; and refund, 3.47.

cases.sql: SELECT c.segment AS segment, COUNT(*) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_customer AS c GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment
cases.answer: Registered customers by segment: member — 5,034, regular — 14,014, and vip — 952.

cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity), 0) AS damaged_units_returned FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.reason = 'damaged' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
assumptions: Count returned units with reason 'damaged'; exclude returns associated with cancelled orders.
cases.answer: A total of 1,950 units were returned because they arrived damaged, excluding returns tied to cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT p.brand AS brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
cases.answer: The five leading brands by units sold in 2025, excluding cancelled orders, were Rasa Nusa (7,073 units), Melati (5,349 units), Sekar (5,114 units), Rupa (5,039 units), and Sari Buah (4,543 units). The date range uses Jakarta local time.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, SUM(t.visitors) AS visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Jumlah pengunjung” berarti total footfall selama bulan kalender Agustus 2026.
Jika ada seri, hanya satu toko teratas yang dikembalikan.
cases.answer: Toko dengan jumlah pengunjung terbanyak pada bulan Agustus 2026 adalah Arunika Jakarta Senayan, dengan total 1.482 pengunjung.

cases.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS late_purchase_orders FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.received_date > po.expected_date GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY late_purchase_orders DESC LIMIT 1
cases.answer: PD Halim (08) had the most late purchase orders, with 182 orders arriving after the expected date.

cases.sql: SELECT s.courier, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS parcels_delivered FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS s WHERE CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.courier ORDER BY s.courier
assumptions: Count parcels by the WIB date they were delivered, rather than the date they were shipped.
cases.answer: In September 2026, parcels delivered by courier were: AnterAja — 124, GoSend — 113, JNE — 338, J&T Express — 314, and SiCepat — 221. Counts are based on the WIB date of delivery.

cases.sql: SELECT s.traffic_source, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code IN ('website', 'app') AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.traffic_source
cases.answer: For website and app sessions in 2025, conversion rates by traffic source were: affiliate, 7.8%; direct, 8.4%; email, 8.3%; organic_search, 8.7%; paid_search, 8.4%; push_notification, 8.4%; and social, 8.2%.

cases.sql: SELECT department.category_name AS category_level_1, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS subcategory ON subcategory.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS department ON department.category_id = subcategory.parent_category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((r.returned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) AND department.level = 1 GROUP BY department.category_name ORDER BY returned_units DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Return during 2025” means the return was processed in WIB during calendar year 2025.
Exclude returns associated with cancelled orders, consistent with the return-rate business rule.
cases.answer: Kategori utama dengan unit return terbanyak selama 2025 adalah Fashion, sebanyak 609 unit. Periode dihitung berdasarkan tanggal pemrosesan return di WIB, dan return dari pesanan yang dibatalkan dikecualikan.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE d.date_key = CAST('2025-11-11' AS DATE) AND d.is_harbolnas
assumptions: Count all orders placed that day, regardless of order status.
cases.answer: There were 183 orders placed on Harbolnas. This count includes orders of all statuses.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: “Last month” means the full calendar month before the as-of date, September 2026; refunds are attributed to the order date.
cases.answer: Net revenue last month was IDR 6.65B IDR. Refunds are attributed to the order date.

cases.sql: WITH daily_orders AS (SELECT d.date_key, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.dim_date AS d LEFT JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = d.date_key WHERE d.is_ramadan = TRUE AND d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.date_key) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(orders) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_orders_per_day FROM daily_orders
assumptions: Menghitung pesanan dengan semua status, termasuk yang dibatalkan.
Rata-rata mencakup semua hari yang ditandai sebagai Ramadan 2025 di kalender, termasuk hari tanpa pesanan.
cases.answer: Rata-rata jumlah pesanan per hari selama Ramadan 2025 adalah 82,1. Perhitungan mencakup semua status pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan, dan semua hari yang ditandai sebagai Ramadan di kalender, termasuk hari tanpa pesanan.

cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.is_weekend THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE d.date_key BETWEEN CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.is_weekend ORDER BY d.is_weekend
assumptions: Count all orders placed, including cancelled orders; the question does not specify completed orders only.
cases.answer: In calendar Q2 2026, 4,009 orders were placed on weekdays and 1,996 on weekends. The count includes all orders, including cancelled orders, and uses the order date in Jakarta time.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, month_start ASC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Busiest month means the calendar month with the most completed orders, counted by WIB order date.
If months tie, return the earliest month.
cases.answer: The busiest month was 2025-03-01, with 2,367 completed orders.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = n.order_date LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026 AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
cases.answer: Pendapatan bersih pada kuartal fiskal pertama FY2026 adalah RpRp 19,9 miliar. Perhitungan mengasumsikan kuartal tersebut mencakup April hingga Juni 2026.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: AOV follows the canonical definition: average order value after line discounts and before refunds, excluding cancelled orders; includes refunded orders.
2025 refers to the WIB calendar year.
cases.answer: The average order value for 2025 was RpIDR 3.56M, calculated after line discounts and before refunds, excluding cancelled orders while including refunded orders, using the WIB calendar year.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS top ON top.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.order_item_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_qty FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_item_id) AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND top.category_name = 'Fashion' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: Fashion refers to the top-level department category.
cases.answer: Dengan mengartikan Fashion sebagai kategori departemen tingkat atas, return rate untuk pesanan sepanjang 2025 adalah 4,9%.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: Use 2026-09-30, the end of the data window, as the as-of date; active customers have at least one completed order in the 90 days up to and including that date.
cases.answer: Using the stated definition—at least one completed order in the ninety days through the end of the data window—there were 3,021 active customers.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'website' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
cases.answer: The website session conversion rate in September 2026 was 8.3%.

cases.sql: WITH order_lines AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(ol.gross_sales_idr) AS gross_sales_idr, SUM(ol.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_lines AS ol LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = ol.order_id
assumptions: Gross sales excludes cancelled orders and is before discounts and refunds; net revenue subtracts line discounts and refunds attributed to the order.
cases.answer: For the stated fiscal year, gross sales were IDR 79.5B IDR and net revenue was IDR 74B IDR. The query uses WIB order dates; gross sales excludes cancelled orders and is before discounts and refunds, while net revenue subtracts line discounts and refunds attributed to the order.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT c.channel_name AS sales_channel, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = n.channel_id GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_name
assumptions: Omzet means net revenue: after line discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: Omzet bersih per channel pada tahun 2025 adalah Marketplace sebesar RpRp 8,81 miliar, Mobile app sebesar RpRp 13,7 miliar, Physical store sebesar RpRp 40,6 miliar, dan Website sebesar RpRp 9,71 miliar. Omzet bersih dihitung setelah diskon dan refund, serta tidak mencakup pesanan yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '12 MONTHS' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT n.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 10
assumptions: “Best customers” means the top 10 registered customers by net revenue over the 12 months up to the as-of date; customer IDs are shown because customer names are not available in the analytics views.
cases.answer: The top customers by net revenue over the query’s lookback period are customer 12244 (IDR 1.24B IDR), customer 330 (IDR 929M IDR), and customer 9236 (IDR 634M IDR). The results include the remaining customers, shown by customer ID because names are unavailable in the analytics views.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS g ON g.region_id = s.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND g.city = 'Jakarta' GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: “Sales” means net revenue after line discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
“Jakarta” means the city Jakarta (not the wider DKI Jakarta province).
No date range was specified, so the query covers all available order data.
cases.answer: Sales in Jakarta were IDR 44.6B IDR in net revenue after line discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders. This covers all available order data and refers to the city of Jakarta, not the wider DKI Jakarta province.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, r.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, r.city), refunds AS (SELECT fr.order_id, SUM(fr.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS fr GROUP BY fr.order_id) SELECT n.city, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(rf.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS rf ON rf.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.city ORDER BY n.city
assumptions: Refunds are attributed to the order's September 2026 date, not the return date.
cases.answer: Net revenue by city in September 2026 was Bekasi: IDR 512M IDR, Bogor: IDR 468M IDR, Depok: IDR 318M IDR, Jakarta: IDR 1.45B IDR, and Tangerang: IDR 612M IDR. Refunds are attributed to the order date rather than the return date.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE r.city = 'Surabaya' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: "Bulan lalu" berarti September 2026, bulan kalender penuh sebelum as-of date 2026-10-01.
Jumlah pesanan mencakup semua status, termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan toko-toko di Surabaya bulan lalu adalah 0. Perhitungan mencakup semua status pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: Count all orders placed in 2025, including cancelled orders, because the question does not specify completed orders.
Row-level security limits results to regions the user is authorized to see; the query does not bypass those restrictions.
cases.answer: The stores with the most orders in 2025 are Arunika Jakarta Senayan with 866 orders, Arunika Bogor Cibinong with 648 orders, and Arunika Tangerang BSD with 645 orders. Counts include cancelled orders, and results are limited to regions you are authorized to see.
